name: [UNOFFICIAL] TaCZ Refabricated (26.3 R1)
description: An unofficial Fabric port of Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero, based on upstream 1.1.8-hotfix. R1 for Minecraft 26.3 is the first build of the 26.3 line, ported from the 26.2 R3-hotfix2 source: it migrates the renderer to Mojang's RenderPearl backend (com.mojang.blaze3d.* -> com.mojang.renderpearl.*), follows vanilla's split of ItemInHandRenderer into FirstPersonHandsAndItems plus FirstPersonHandsAndItemsRenderer, and updates the scope shaders to ShaderC #include. Compatibility integrations for REI, Zoomify and Shoulder Surfing Reloaded are DISABLED in this build because those mods have no Minecraft 26.3 release yet; they are not removed and return once upstream ships 26.3 builds. R1 also reworks the Iris 26.3 scope-mask mode detection, adds pipeline prewarming, migrates block loot tables to the 26.3 schema, parses gun-smith recipe ingredients lazily so legacy gun packs no longer break world loading, and opts vanilla recipe serializers into Fabric recipe sync so client JEI works on dedicated servers without JEI. Verified in-game by the maintainer (vanilla, Iris, dedicated server) in September 2026; see docs/CHANGELOG_26_3_R1.md for what is and is not covered. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the TACZ Dev Team. The version keeps 1.1.8 as its SemVer core and uses '+fabric.26.3.R1' build metadata so existing gun-pack version requirements continue to work.
contributors: TACZ Dev Team (upstream Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero)
